_doc: How each look of nebula plume is drawn in the battle (src/Game/View/PlumeLooks.cs, read into src/Game/View/nebula_plume.gdshader by NebulaPlume; owner, 2026-11-10: "something like a 3d noise texture would be cool? something like how Ace Combat 7 does clouds, entering a column of nebula plume can hide you from enemies", "some nebulas are ion storms, which will have cool lightning"). One look per NebulaDef.Looks and no other; a scenario's plume names its look (scenarios.json nebulae[].look). The view only: what a plume does to a ship is data/battle/systems/cloak.json (nebula). A plume is a column of cloud marched through a tiling 3D noise (assets/space/plume_noise.bin, tools/space/plume_noise.py), its circle on the battle plane the rule's own (radius 1 is NebulaDef.RM). lit is the cloud where the sun reaches it, deep the cloud in its own shadow, glow the light its thin edges give off and glow_strength how much (0 to 2); height_r how far the column stands over the plane, in the plume's radii; anvil how far its head spreads past the stem (0 none, 0.8 a storm's anvil), under towers of different heights that round over (the shape is NebulaPlume.Cover, baked into a small 3D texture of the plume's own); absorption how fast the cloud swallows light, per radius of thick cloud (a ship one radius inside shows through exp(-absorption * density)); clear_km how far from the camera the cloud is back to its full thickness, in km (it thins toward the camera, so a captain inside a plume still sees their own ship); base_scale how many times the noise repeats across a radius (the size of the billows) and detail_scale the same for the wisps that eat their edges, erosion how deep those bite (0 to 1); drift_per_s how fast the billows rise, in repeats a second. flash is the colour of an ion storm's lightning and flashes_per_min how often it flickers in the cloud where a scenario makes the plume a storm (the view's own lightning; the strikes that trip a core are the simulation's, Battle.Lightning). Provisional until the owner has seen them (survey NP).
